newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Casinos Austria makes half year loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Casinos Austria makes half year loss.

text.p: Casino operator Casinos Austria International Ltd (CAIL) reported on Friday an after tax loss of A$2.3 million for the six months to June 30, 1996, while operating revenue rose 47 percent to A$42.1 million.
CAIL, which is controlled by Casinos Austria Ag, reported a net profit of A$3.28 million in the calendar 1995 half.

"As forecast in our announcement of financial results for the 1995 December year-end, we anticipated that this year's trading conditions for CAIL, and indeed, the industry as a whole would continue to be difficult," CAIL chief executive officer Alex Tucek said in a statement.
CAIL said the long-term financial performance of the company will be further boosted by a major capital injection of up to A$18 million by the parent company Casinos Austria Ag.
Tucek said details of the capital injection are to be finalised during the next few weeks and would be means of a private share placement. Shareholders approval would be sought.

"This funding will serve two strategic purposes - firstly, to reduce borrowings and therefore strengthening our balance sheet, and secondly and more importantly, to allow the group to actively pursue developments opportunities in key gaming markets throughout the world," Tucek said.
"We are looking forward to future development activities, including prospects in New Zealand and South Africa," Tucek said. CAIL shares closed steady at 50 cents on Friday.
